items.title: Using the AWS RMiT workbook and ISO Compliance Guides to support your BNM submissions
items.summary: Your next Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) notification submission needs auditable evidence of how Amazon Web Services (AWS) controls align with Risk Management in Technology (RMiT) requirements. Two resources now exist to support that work: the AWS Workbook for BNM RMiT and the compliance guides published by AWS Security Assurance Services (AWS SAS). The AWS Workbook […]
